rules.name: Suppress missing blockstate model variant warnings
rules.pattern: Exception loading blockstate definition: '.+' missing model for variant: '.+'

rules.name: Suppress missing model warnings
rules.pattern: Unable to load model: '.+' referenced from: .+: java\.io\.FileNotFoundException: .+\.json

rules.name: Suppress missing model texture warnings
rules.pattern: Missing textures in model .+:\s*minecraft:textures/.+\.png:.+

rules.name: Suppress invalid blockstate property value warnings
rules.pattern: Exception loading blockstate definition: '.+' in resourcepack: '.+' for variant: '.+': Unknown value: '.+' for blockstate property: '.+' \[.+\]

rules.name: Suppress invalid sprite frame index warnings
rules.pattern: Invalid frame index on sprite .+ frame \d+: \d+

rules.name: Suppress Diagonal Blocks incompatible model warnings
rules.pattern: Block '.+' is using incompatible model '.+' and should be added to the '.+' block tag\. The model will not appear correctly under some circumstances!

rules.name: Suppress Puzzles Lib model bake warnings
rules.pattern: Unable to bake model: '.+': java\.lang\.RuntimeException: Unknown value '.+' for property '.+' on 'Block\{.+\}' in '.+'

rules.name: Suppress Zeta recipe scan errors
rules.pattern: Failed to scan recipe .+\. This should be reported to .+!

rules.name: Suppress Immersive Engineering recipe analysis warnings
rules.pattern: Couldn't fully analyze \d+ .+, missing knowledge for \{.+\}

rules.name: Suppress Feeder Helmet recipe creation logs
rules.pattern: Feeder Helmet created feeder_module recipe for .+:.+ with id '.+:.+'

rules.name: Suppress NeoForge mob category mismatch warnings
rules.pattern: Detected .+:.+ that was registered with .+ mob category but was added under .+ mob category for .+:.+ biome! Mobs should be added to biomes under the same mob category that the mob was registered as to prevent mob cap spawning issues\.

rules.name: Suppress recipe unknown registry key errors
rules.pattern: Error parsing recipe .+: Unknown registry key in ResourceKey\[.+ / .+\]: .+

rules.name: Suppress recipe too many fluid inputs errors
rules.pattern: Error parsing recipe .+: Recipe has more fluid inputs \(\d+\) than supported \(\d+\)\.

rules.name: Suppress JSON resource parse errors
rules.pattern: Couldn't parse data file .+ from .+\.json

rules.name: Suppress recipe parsing error loading recipe
rules.pattern: Parsing error loading recipe [^\s]+

rules.name: Suppress RecipeManager complex recipe parse errors
rules.pattern: Error parsing recipe .+: Failed to parse either\..*

rules.name: Suppress LootDataType parse errors
rules.pattern: Couldn't parse element ResourceKey\[.+\]:.+ - .+

rules.name: Suppress HammerLib built tags
rules.pattern: Built tags for registry .+

rules.name: Suppress KubeJS recipe fallback warnings
rules.pattern: KubeRecipe\.java#\d+: Failed to parse recipe '.+'! Falling back to vanilla: .+

rules.name: Suppress unknown recipe type warnings
rules.pattern: Skipping recipe .+, unknown type: .+

rules.name: Suppress RecipeManager ingredient parse errors
rules.pattern: Error parsing recipe .+: No key tag in MapLike\[.+\]; No key item in MapLike\[.+\]

rules.name: Suppress Malum spirit drop registration
rules.pattern: Added spirit drops for entity with registry name: .+

rules.name: Suppress Silent Gear trait decoding
rules.pattern: Decoding trait ".+" in pack ".+"

rules.name: Suppress Silent Gear material decoding
rules.pattern: Decoding material ".+" in pack ".+"

rules.name: Suppress C2ME density function compilation
rules.pattern: Density function compilation finished in \d+ ms

rules.name: Suppress Biolith unknown dimension warnings
rules.pattern: Ignoring world '.+'; unknown dimension type: .+

rules.name: Suppress NoStructureOverlap startup messages
rules.pattern: NoStructureOverlap: .+ level loaded - structure overlap prevention active

rules.name: Suppress unknown data attachment warnings
rules.pattern: Encountered unknown or non-serializable data attachment .+\. Skipping\.

rules.name: Suppress Villager API map decoration info
rules.pattern: Found .+ map decoration: .+

rules.name: Suppress Villager API treasure map offer failures
rules.pattern: Failed to create treasure map offer for tag: .+ with decoration: .+\. This usually means no structures matching the tag were found nearby, or the structure tag doesn't exist\.

rules.name: Suppress Villager API missing buy trade item errors
rules.pattern: Villager type .+ does not have a corresponding item in .+ buy trade, and .+ fallback is also missing!

rules.name: Suppress Villager API dynamic decorations list
rules.pattern: Available dynamic decorations: \[.*\]

rules.name: Suppress TMRV duplicate JEI category warnings
rules.pattern: JEI category with ID `.+` already exists in .+!

rules.name: Suppress Villager API missing map decoration errors
rules.pattern: Map decoration not found: .+

rules.name: Suppress TMRV load info messages
rules.pattern: \[.+\] Loaded in .+

rules.name: Suppress Patchouli book content load timing
rules.pattern: BookContentResourceListenerLoader: Files found in .+ μs
